vb_textbox.text: You only have 1.5 seconds to select s (left gnome) and k (right gnome) so make sure you are quick with your selections. X5 are most important so make your selection count when you see X5 but even the X1 still adds to your score. Pink, purple and brown gnomes gave me the most so really good Blue and red gnomes gave me an ok amount so goodGreen and yellow didnt give me quite so many mushrooms so not so good Pink, purple, brown - really goodblue and red - ok green and yellow - not so good the 1.5 is quick but not as quick as you may think it is so quickly think and the select S or K then press SPACE also very quickly otherwise you  wont get any mushrooms Good Luck & Have fun :)
